title: Strong L²(B_R) convergence implies convergence of the pairings with a fixed L² function
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, R ∈ ℝ and μ := Lebesgue measure restricted to B_R := B̆_R(0) ⊆ ℝⁿ (ℝⁿ = Euclid n). Let f_j : ℝⁿ → ℝ (j ∈ ℕ), W : ℝⁿ → ℝ and g : ℝⁿ → ℝ all belong to L²(μ) (MemLp · 2 μ), and suppose ∫_{B_R} (f_j − W)² → 0 as j → ∞. Then ∫_{B_R} f_j·g → ∫_{B_R} W·g as j → ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (f : ℕ → Euclid n → ℝ) (W g : Euclid n → ℝ), (∀ j, MemLp (f j) 2 (volume.restrict (ball (0 : Euclid n) R))) → MemLp W 2 (volume.restrict (ball (0 : Euclid n) R)) → MemLp g 2 (volume.restrict (ball (0 : Euclid n) R)) → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) R, (f j x - W x) ^ 2) atTop (𝓝 0) → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) R, f j x * g x) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) R, W x * g x))
